key_provisions.requirement: Every industrial establishment with 300 or more workers must have certified Standing Orders covering classification, shifts, attendance, leave, termination, suspension, misconduct, grievance redressal.
policy_checklist: Establishments with 300+ workers must have certified Standing Orders
HR policy must be consistent with Standing Orders

key_provisions.requirement: Retrenchment compensation = 15 days average pay per completed year of service. 3 months notice or pay in lieu required. Last-in-first-out rule applies.
policy_checklist: Policy must specify retrenchment compensation: 15 days pay per year
Must state 3 months notice for retrenchment

key_provisions.requirement: Every establishment with 20 or more workers must have a Grievance Redressal Committee with equal employer-worker representation. Must resolve grievances within 30 days.
policy_checklist: Establishments with 20+ workers must have GRC

key_provisions.requirement: Workers must give 14 days notice before strike. No strike during conciliation or arbitration proceedings.
policy_checklist: Policy must inform workers of 14-day strike notice requirement
Must contain grievance escalation procedure as alternative

key_provisions.requirement: Fixed Term Employee entitled to same wages and benefits as permanent employee. Entitled to gratuity after 1 year (not 5 years).
policy_checklist: Fixed term policy must guarantee parity with permanent employees
Must state gratuity eligibility from 1 year for fixed term employees
